"""Static kit checks only; never launches the workflow or mechanism tests."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ast
from hashlib import sha256
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--packet', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    directory = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    driver_path = directory / 'run_exception_delivery_ci.py'
    workflow_path = directory / 'exception-delivery-development.workflow.template.yml'
    raw = driver_path.read_bytes()
    tree = ast.parse(raw)
    compile(tree, str(driver_path), 'exec')
    for path in (Path(__file__),):
        compile(path.read_bytes(), str(path), 'exec')
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('frozen_development_driver', driver_path)
    driver = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(driver)
    checks = {}

    def check(name, value):
        if not value:
            raise AssertionError(name)
        checks[name] = True

    check('exact_base_head', driver.BASE_HEAD == '7e9c5a796a29746d169f9db97392ec774f627c03')
    check('exact_base_tree', driver.BASE_TREE == '79843bddc6df7306299f0be6475a2fcd187b4d97')
    check('complete_file_count', driver.BASE_FILES == 3084)
    check('original_artifact', driver.ORIGINAL_ARTIFACT_ID == 13910483391 and driver.ORIGINAL_ARTIFACT_BYTES == 68873189
          and driver.ORIGINAL_ARTIFACT_SHA == '082cf9245a6c46959acf75be6c981fa87a6b4f3babaca95232166a9b2fc4e528')
    check('original_compiler', driver.COMPILER_BYTES == 669494 and driver.COMPILER_SHA == '81b6fad94493546b5bf3f858248f25b19aded88bf8f3aaad18140aa317dac109')
    files = driver.packet_files(args.packet)
    check('all_original_packet_members_checked', len(files) == 49)
    check('two_new_product_files_only', set(driver.SOURCE_FILES) == {'hepta/hia_exception_delivery.py', 'tools/hia_exception_delivery.py'})
    for name, digest in driver.SOURCE_FILES.items():
        check('frozen_' + name, sha256(files['source/' + name]).hexdigest() == digest)
    controls = ast.parse(files['recovery-r4/test_exception_delivery_mechanism.py'])
    methods = [node.name for node in controls.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == 'DeliveryMechanismTests'
               for node in node.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name.startswith('test_')]
    check('all_18_controls', len(methods) == 18 and len(set(methods)) == 18)
    check('no_skip_added', not any(isinstance(node, ast.Attribute) and node.attr.startswith('skip') for node in ast.walk(controls)))
    inner = {}
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id in ('script', 'controls_script') for target in node.targets):
            code = ast.literal_eval(node.value)
            compile(code, '<independent child>', 'exec')
            inner[node.targets[0].id] = {'bytes': len(code.encode()), 'sha256': sha256(code.encode()).hexdigest()}
    check('both_child_programs_compile', set(inner) == {'script', 'controls_script'})
    text = raw.decode()
    check('python3144_exact_admission', 'sys.version_info[:3] != (3, 14, 4)' in text)
    check('original_compile_stage_not_replaced', 'compile_stage(' not in text and 'admit_cold_build' not in text)
    check('all_original_source_readback', text.count('source_snapshot(root, original_blobs=True)') == 2)
    check('new_overlay_final_identity', "report['git_status_after'] != expected_status" in text)
    check('source_export_not_forged_git', "['git', '-C', str(root), *args]" in text and 'git init' not in text)
    check('independent_isolated_children', text.count("sys.executable, '-I', '-S', '-B', '-c'") == 2)
    check('native_child_outer_bound', 'root, environment, 60)' in text)
    check('mechanism_outer_bound', 'root, environment, 30)' in text)
    workflow = workflow_path.read_text()
    check('workflow_source_pin', 'ref: ' + driver.BASE_HEAD in workflow)
    check('workflow_python_pin', "python-version: '3.14.4'" in workflow)
    check('workflow_outer240_plus3', 'timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=3s 240s' in workflow)
    check('workflow_upload_even_failure', 'if: always()' in workflow and 'actions/upload-artifact@v4' in workflow)
    check('workflow_no_continue_on_error', 'continue-on-error' not in workflow)
    check('workflow_read_only_permissions', 'contents: read' in workflow and 'actions: read' in workflow and ': write' not in workflow)
    check('only_future_kit_identity_placeholders', set(re.findall(r'__[A-Z_]+__', workflow)) == {'__IMMUTABLE_KIT_BLOB__', '__IMMUTABLE_KIT_SHA256__'})
    check('mechanism_blob_and_sha_fixed', driver.PACKET_BLOB in workflow and driver.PACKET_SHA in workflow)
    lines = workflow.splitlines()
    shell_blocks = []
    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
        if line == '        run: |':
            block = []
            for following in lines[index + 1:]:
                if following and not following.startswith('          '):
                    break
                block.append(following[10:] if following else '')
            shell = '\n'.join(block) + '\n'
            completed = subprocess.run(['bash', '-n'], input=shell.encode(), capture_output=True, timeout=10)
            if completed.returncode:
                raise AssertionError(completed.stderr.decode())
            shell_blocks.append({'bytes': len(shell.encode()), 'sha256': sha256(shell.encode()).hexdigest()})
            for nested in re.findall(r"python - <<'PY'\n(.*?)\nPY\n", shell, re.S):
                compile(nested, '<workflow bootstrap>', 'exec')
    check('all_four_workflow_shell_blocks', len(shell_blocks) == 4)
    print(json.dumps({'schema': 'hia.exception-delivery.ci-kit-static-controls.v1',
        'status': 'STATIC_CONTROLS_PASS_NOT_CI_EXECUTED', 'checks': checks, 'check_count': len(checks),
        'driver': {'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha256(raw).hexdigest()},
        'workflow': {'bytes': len(workflow.encode()), 'sha256': sha256(workflow.encode()).hexdigest()},
        'inner_child_programs': inner, 'shell_blocks': shell_blocks, 'mechanism_methods': methods,
        'python': sys.version, 'actual_python314_mechanism_executed': False}, sort_keys=True, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

CI-KIT.md.text:
# Independent CPython 3.14.4 development kit

This kit is authored for review and has not been dispatched by its author.
The local Python 3.12.14 mechanism observations are separate evidence. Root
publishes and starts the one isolated workflow after reviewing these bytes.

The only template substitutions are the actual immutable kit Git blob and the
SHA256 of its complete JSON bytes. They deliberately are not invented here:
the template itself is a kit member, so an embedded self-hash would be circular.
The mechanism source/evidence packet already is frozen as Git blob
`538b30f50a052130c5c84c82bb50062e83f6a030`, SHA256
`602deac844fe2ea360c4ca239563f2fe10128c4adbb8105cfa1a7db8c7915a65`.

Run this workflow in the connected `TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta` repository
with its read-only Actions token. A different harness repository must use an
already authorized read credential selected by root; no new secret name or
unapproved cross-repository access is assumed by this template.

## Inputs and phases

1. Check out exact commit `7e9c5a796a29746d169f9db97392ec774f627c03`, tree
   `79843bddc6df7306299f0be6475a2fcd187b4d97`, as a complete clean Git source
   tree. The driver verifies all 3084 tracked Git blob identities and modes;
   a component-only export cannot masquerade as this source.
2. Require actual CPython 3.14.4, the same setup-python/checkout action versions
   as the original 7e9 Core workflow, GNU `as`, and `objcopy`.
   No Rust, Lean, Z3, Clang, publisher or complete Agent runtime is needed for
   this bounded byte producer and physical mechanism. No third-party Python
   package is needed: the actual local `-I -S` import/render observation loaded
   no site package and regenerated the exact 5523 bytes. The CI children also
   use `-I -S -B` with explicit source/helper paths. Version/tool identities
   and raw setup output are retained. Missing prerequisites fail, not skip.
3. Admit the complete frozen packet and all 50 archive members by exact byte
   lengths and SHA256. Add only the two shared source files. Original tracked
   files remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Copy the external component wrapper,
   independent GNU instruction source and 18-test suite into the new evidence
   scope, outside the Git tree.
4. Retrieve the actual original ac3 Actions artifact 13910483391. Its ZIP must
   be exactly 68873189 bytes with SHA256
   `082cf9245a6c46959acf75be6c981fa87a6b4f3babaca95232166a9b2fc4e528`.
   Read only the exact B3 image and original receipt members, rejecting absent
   or duplicate members. The image must be 669494 bytes with SHA256
   `81b6fad94493546b5bf3f858248f25b19aded88bf8f3aaad18140aa317dac109`.
   Preserve the used image, receipt and original archive metadata in output.
   Do not admit any historical cold report as current-source qualification.
5. Regenerate the standalone HIA wrapper; compare all output bytes with the
   independently assembled `.S` reference and all 19 complete ordinary-VM
   cases. Compile it once with the actual retained image using unchanged
   `compile_stage` and its 20-second child limit. Compare the real native image
   to every VM result, source buffer, output buffer, workspace and canary.
6. Run all 18 physical mechanism methods using the newly HIA-produced bytes:
   exact exception and StopIteration values, cause/context/notes, handled
   error state during temporary retirement, no-GC lifetime and reference
   counts, actual RX/R permissions, invalid frames, concurrent calls, reentry,
   cleanup failures and actual line/opcode close interruptions. Preserve the
   explicit controlled-transport negative tests as such.
7. Recheck every original tracked source, both new sources, external helpers,
   packet and actual compiler. The only allowed Git status is the two new
   files. A changed HEAD, tree, tracked file, helper, new unexpected source or
   image fails final custody. Always retain reports, raw stdout/stderr, exact
   current HIA/source images, both original failure records, commands and input
   snapshots. The old full 68 MB archive is not duplicated in the new upload;
   its whole identity and the exact actually used B3/receipt bytes are retained.

The single generation/native child has a 60-second outer limit around its
unchanged 20-second compile child. Mechanism controls have a 30-second outer
limit. The complete driver has an independent 240-second / 3-second GNU timeout
supervisor. This does not run or alter the repository's 180+3 cold gate, full
qualification limits, or original service timing limits.

Success here means this fixed HIA-produced hosted CPython mechanism passed on
the stated interpreter. It does not certify service-context/Code/ELF cleanup
permissions, the whole public input domain, a current-source cold chain,
default selection, full-stack native closure, or deletion of any legacy path.

exception-delivery-development.workflow..text:
name: HIA exception delivery independent development
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
jobs:
  exception-delivery:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
      KIT_BLOB: '__IMMUTABLE_KIT_BLOB__'
      KIT_SHA256: '__IMMUTABLE_KIT_SHA256__'
      MECHANISM_BLOB: '538b30f50a052130c5c84c82bb50062e83f6a030'
      MECHANISM_SHA256: '602deac844fe2ea360c4ca239563f2fe10128c4adbb8105cfa1a7db8c7915a65'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta
          ref: 7e9c5a796a29746d169f9db97392ec774f627c03
          path: source
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.14.4'
      - name: Create exclusive development evidence scope
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -m 700 "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-exception-delivery-v75"
          mkdir -m 700 "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-exception-delivery-v75/inputs"
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          out=Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'hia-exception-delivery-v75/inputs'
          names=('GITHUB_REPOSITORY','GITHUB_SHA','GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF','GITHUB_RUN_ID','GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT','RUNNER_OS','RUNNER_ARCH')
          (out/'workflow-context.json').write_text(json.dumps({key:os.environ.get(key) for key in names},indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
          PY
      - name: Confirm the interpreter and independent reference tools
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -I -S -B -c 'import sys; assert sys.implementation.name == "cpython" and sys.version_info[:3] == (3, 14, 4); print(sys.version)' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-exception-delivery-v75/inputs/python-version.txt"
          command -v as
          command -v objcopy
      - name: Retrieve immutable kit and original retained compiler artifact
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-exception-delivery-v75"
          gh api "repos/TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta/git/blobs/$KIT_BLOB" > "$root/inputs/kit.response.json"
          gh api "repos/TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta/git/blobs/$MECHANISM_BLOB" > "$root/inputs/mechanism.response.json"
          python - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import base64, hashlib, json, os
          root=Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'hia-exception-delivery-v75/inputs'
          for name,variable in [('kit','KIT_SHA256'),('mechanism','MECHANISM_SHA256')]:
              response=json.loads((root/(name+'.response.json')).read_bytes())
              assert response['encoding']=='base64'
              raw=base64.b64decode(response['content'])
              assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==os.environ[variable]
              (root/(name+'.json')).write_bytes(raw)
          kit=json.loads((root/'kit.json').read_bytes())
          assert kit['schema']=='hia.exception-delivery.python314-ci-kit.v1'
          assert set(kit['files'])=={'run_exception_delivery_ci.py','exception-delivery-development.workflow.template.yml','CI-KIT.md','validate_exception_delivery_ci_kit.py'}
          for name,record in kit['files'].items():
              assert name==Path(name).name and name not in ('.','..')
              raw=record['text'].encode('utf-8')
              assert len(raw)==record['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==record['sha256']

          gh api repos/TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta/actions/artifacts/13910483391/zip > "$root/original-ac3.zip"
      - name: Run one complete-source HIA mechanism development job
        shell: bash

          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=3s 240s python -I -S -B "$root/inputs/run_exception_delivery_ci.py" --source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/source" --source-packet "$root/inputs/mechanism.json" --original-artifact "$root/original-ac3.zip" --out "$root/output"
      - name: Retain complete new observations and exact used compiler bytes
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:

          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-exception-delivery-v75/inputs

"""One independent complete-7e9 / CPython-3.14.4 DEVELOPMENT job.

Do not invoke a cold builder with the historical report. The original ac3 B3
bytes are pinned development input only. This driver neither changes a ref nor
repeats an unknown job. Each output directory is exclusive and all new raw
observations survive failures for the workflow's always-upload step.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import base64
from hashlib import sha1, sha256
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import traceback
import zipfile

REPOSITORY = 'TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta'
BASE_HEAD = '7e9c5a796a29746d169f9db97392ec774f627c03'
BASE_TREE = '79843bddc6df7306299f0be6475a2fcd187b4d97'
BASE_FILES = 3084
PACKET_BLOB = '538b30f50a052130c5c84c82bb50062e83f6a030'
PACKET_SHA = '602deac844fe2ea360c4ca239563f2fe10128c4adbb8105cfa1a7db8c7915a65'
PACKET_BYTES = 360092
PACKET_ARCHIVE_SHA = 'c3f9f89cd122609b7f94c71beea35c7e8fa07f2eddc82f57419e1393a0f0467a'
PACKET_ARCHIVE_BYTES = 269882
ORIGINAL_ARTIFACT_ID = 13910483391
ORIGINAL_ARTIFACT_BYTES = 68873189
ORIGINAL_ARTIFACT_SHA = '082cf9245a6c46959acf75be6c981fa87a6b4f3babaca95232166a9b2fc4e528'
COMPILER_MEMBER = 'hia-cold.cold/qualification.evidence/B3.image.bin'
COMPILER_SHA = '81b6fad94493546b5bf3f858248f25b19aded88bf8f3aaad18140aa317dac109'
COMPILER_BYTES = 669494
RECEIPT_MEMBER = 'hia-cold.cold/qualification.evidence/B3.receipt.json'
RECEIPT_SHA = '80b0a2f4fe9c31f9a5f97193f6aef305eafb05b6c95075f337213be20e7df572'
SOURCE_FILES = {
    'hepta/hia_exception_delivery.py': '4aba0b4321d63478eee2303ccbae9b6d58124090d08c0059e4ad4c45ed355952',
    'tools/hia_exception_delivery.py': '788b4d0914ce6aa8f34eee24fb8a77bdff17b91e717329cc596b8cb23e41b5ac',
}
EXPECTED_HIA_SOURCE = 'd8775a923e974a34542e51c751698b3eced92fb49b95b2e9e9bcc598be33b943'
EXPECTED_HIA_IMAGE = '28daeb55102a8f39f20d64d8105c7ef1efac61ce097afe4f501302e31e3dc99f'


def unique_pairs(pairs):
    result = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        if key in result:
            raise ValueError('duplicate JSON field')
        result[key] = value
    return result


def json_value(raw):
    return json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=unique_pairs)


def write_json(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')


def identity(path):
    path = Path(path)
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    return {'path': str(path), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha256(raw).hexdigest()}


def git(root, *args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(root), *args], capture_output=True, timeout=30)
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError('Git identity command failed: ' + result.stderr.decode(errors='replace'))
    return result.stdout


def source_snapshot(root, *, original_blobs):
    result = {}
    for row in git(root, 'ls-files', '--stage', '-z').split(b'\0'):
        if not row:
            continue
        meta, name = row.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, blob, stage = meta.decode('ascii').split()
        if stage != '0' or mode not in ('100644', '100755', '120000'):
            raise ValueError('nonordinary original Git input')
        relative = os.fsdecode(name)
        path = root / relative
        if mode == '120000':
            if not path.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError('original symbolic link changed type')
            raw = os.fsencode(os.readlink(path))
        else:
            info = path.lstat()
            if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or bool(info.st_mode & 0o111) != (mode == '100755'):
                raise ValueError('original file kind or executable mode changed')
            raw = path.read_bytes()
        observed_blob = sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(raw)).encode() + b'\0' + raw).hexdigest()
        if original_blobs and observed_blob != blob.decode():
            raise ValueError('full checkout file differs from its original Git blob: ' + relative)
        result[relative] = {'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                            'git_blob': observed_blob, 'git_mode': mode}
    return result


def packet_files(path):
    raw = Path(path).read_bytes()
    if len(raw) != PACKET_BYTES or sha256(raw).hexdigest() != PACKET_SHA:
        raise ValueError('frozen mechanism packet identity mismatch')
    packet = json_value(raw)
    archive = base64.b64decode(packet['archive_base64'], validate=True)
    if (len(archive) != PACKET_ARCHIVE_BYTES or sha256(archive).hexdigest() != PACKET_ARCHIVE_SHA
            or type(packet['member_count']) is not int or packet['member_count'] != 50):
        raise ValueError('frozen mechanism evidence archive differs')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive)) as zipped:
        names = zipped.namelist()
        if len(names) != 50 or len(set(names)) != len(names):
            raise ValueError('frozen mechanism archive member inventory differs')
        manifest = json_value(zipped.read('MANIFEST.json'))
        if set(names) != set(manifest['files']) | {'MANIFEST.json'}:
            raise ValueError('frozen mechanism archive manifest coverage differs')
        files = {}
        for name, expected in manifest['files'].items():
            raw_file = zipped.read(name)
            if len(raw_file) != expected['bytes'] or sha256(raw_file).hexdigest() != expected['sha256']:
                raise ValueError('frozen mechanism archive file changed: ' + name)
            files[name] = raw_file
    return files


def retained_compiler(archive, directory):
    archive = Path(archive)
    raw = archive.read_bytes()
    if len(raw) != ORIGINAL_ARTIFACT_BYTES or sha256(raw).hexdigest() != ORIGINAL_ARTIFACT_SHA:
        raise ValueError('original ac3 Actions artifact identity differs')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as zipped:
        names = zipped.namelist()
        for member in (COMPILER_MEMBER, RECEIPT_MEMBER):
            if names.count(member) != 1:
                raise ValueError('original retained input is absent or ambiguous: ' + member)
        compiler, receipt = zipped.read(COMPILER_MEMBER), zipped.read(RECEIPT_MEMBER)
    if len(compiler) != COMPILER_BYTES or sha256(compiler).hexdigest() != COMPILER_SHA:
        raise ValueError('original B3 byte identity differs')
    if len(receipt) != 1677 or sha256(receipt).hexdigest() != RECEIPT_SHA:
        raise ValueError('original B3 receipt identity differs')
    directory.mkdir()
    target = directory / 'B3.image.bin'
    target.write_bytes(compiler)
    target.chmod(0o444)
    (directory / 'B3.original.receipt.json').write_bytes(receipt)
    write_json(directory / 'CUSTODY.json', {'repository': REPOSITORY, 'artifact_id': ORIGINAL_ARTIFACT_ID,
        'original_archive': identity(archive), 'original_image_member': COMPILER_MEMBER,
        'original_receipt_member': RECEIPT_MEMBER, 'image': identity(target),
        'original_receipt_sha256': RECEIPT_SHA, 'scope': 'DEVELOPMENT_ONLY_REUSED_COMPILER',
        'current_source_cold': False, 'old_cold_admission_used': False})
    return target


def child(directory, label, argv, cwd, environment, timeout):
    started = time.monotonic()
    record = {'argv': argv, 'cwd': str(cwd), 'timeout_seconds': timeout}
    write_json(directory / (label + '.intent.json'), record)
    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, env=environment, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
        (directory / (label + '.stdout.log')).write_bytes(error.stdout or b'')
        (directory / (label + '.stderr.log')).write_bytes(error.stderr or b'')
        record.update({'timed_out': True, 'exit_code': None, 'elapsed_seconds': time.monotonic() - started})
        write_json(directory / (label + '.terminal.json'), record)
        raise
    (directory / (label + '.stdout.log')).write_bytes(completed.stdout)
    (directory / (label + '.stderr.log')).write_bytes(completed.stderr)
    record.update({'timed_out': False, 'exit_code': completed.returncode,
                   'elapsed_seconds': time.monotonic() - started})
    write_json(directory / (label + '.terminal.json'), record)
    if completed.returncode:
        raise AssertionError('single original child failed: ' + label)
    return record


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--source-root', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--source-packet', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--original-artifact', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--out', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root, out = args.source_root.resolve(strict=True), args.out.absolute()
    if out == root or root in out.parents:
        raise ValueError('evidence must be outside the complete source checkout')
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
    report = {'schema': 'hia.exception-delivery.python314-development.v1', 'status': 'STARTED',
        'base_head': BASE_HEAD, 'base_tree': BASE_TREE, 'source_packet_blob': PACKET_BLOB,
        'current_source_cold': False, 'whole_service_owner': False, 'code_elf_owner': False,
        'whole_stack_native': False, 'default_enabled': False, 'legacy_deletion': False,
        'compiler_child_timeout_seconds': 20, 'outer_workflow_timeout_seconds': 240,
        'python': {'version': sys.version, 'implementation': sys.implementation.name,
                   'executable': identity(Path(sys.executable).resolve())}}
    before = None
    modified = []
    try:
        if sys.implementation.name != 'cpython' or sys.version_info[:3] != (3, 14, 4):
            raise RuntimeError('this independent workflow requires actual CPython 3.14.4')
        if git(root, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() != BASE_HEAD:
            raise ValueError('complete source HEAD is not exact 7e9')
        if git(root, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}').decode().strip() != BASE_TREE:
            raise ValueError('complete source tree is not exact 7e9')
        if Path(git(root, 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel').decode().strip()).resolve() != root:
            raise ValueError('source checkout is an ancestor, not the declared isolated root')
        if git(root, 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'):
            raise ValueError('original complete source checkout is not clean')
        before = source_snapshot(root, original_blobs=True)
        if len(before) != BASE_FILES:
            raise ValueError('full 7e9 tracked file count differs')
        write_json(out / 'source-before.json', before)
        report['independent_reference_tools'] = {}
        for name in ('as', 'objcopy'):
            executable = shutil.which(name)
            if not executable:
                raise RuntimeError('required independent reference tool is missing: ' + name)
            version = subprocess.run([executable, '--version'], capture_output=True, timeout=10)
            (out / (name + '.version.stdout.log')).write_bytes(version.stdout)
            (out / (name + '.version.stderr.log')).write_bytes(version.stderr)
            if version.returncode:
                raise RuntimeError('required reference tool version query failed: ' + name)
            report['independent_reference_tools'][name] = identity(Path(executable).resolve())
        files = packet_files(args.source_packet)
        (out / 'original-mechanism-r3-capsule.json').write_bytes(args.source_packet.read_bytes())
        overlay = out / 'source-overlay'
        overlay.mkdir()
        for relative, expected in SOURCE_FILES.items():
            target, raw = root / relative, files['source/' + relative]
            if target.exists() or sha256(raw).hexdigest() != expected:
                raise ValueError('new shared source admission failed: ' + relative)
            target.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True, parents=True)
            target.write_bytes(raw)
            target.chmod(0o644)
            if target.read_bytes() != raw:
                raise ValueError('new shared source publication readback differs')
            copied = overlay / relative
            copied.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True, parents=True)
            copied.write_bytes(raw)
            modified.append(target)
        helpers = out / 'helpers'
        helpers.mkdir()
        for name in ('delivery_component.py', 'test_exception_delivery_mechanism.py', 'exception_delivery_reference.S'):
            raw = files['recovery-r4/' + name]
            (helpers / name).write_bytes(raw)
        (helpers / Path(__file__).name).write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
        compiler = retained_compiler(args.original_artifact, out / 'retained-compiler')
        held = {str(path): identity(path) for path in [*modified, compiler, *helpers.iterdir(), args.source_packet]}
        write_json(out / 'held-inputs-before.json', held)
        environment = dict(os.environ)
        removed = [key for key in environment if key.startswith('HEPTA_HIA_')]
        for key in removed:
            environment.pop(key)
        environment['PYTHONPATH'] = str(root)
        environment['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'
        report['removed_selector_names'] = removed
        native = out / 'native'
        native.mkdir()
        script = ('import sys,json;sys.path[:0]=[sys.argv[1],sys.argv[5]];from delivery_component import run;'
                  'r=run(sys.argv[2],sys.argv[3],sys.argv[4]);'
                  'print(json.dumps({"source":r["source_sha256"],"image":r["image_sha256"],'
                  '"complete_comparisons":len(r["comparisons"])}))')
        report['generation_and_native'] = child(out, 'generation-and-native',
            [sys.executable, '-I', '-S', '-B', '-c', script, str(helpers), str(native), str(compiler),
             str(helpers / 'exception_delivery_reference.S'), str(root)], root, environment, 60)
        produced = json_value((native / 'RESULT.json').read_bytes())
        if (produced['source_sha256'] != EXPECTED_HIA_SOURCE or produced['image_sha256'] != EXPECTED_HIA_IMAGE
                or len(produced['comparisons']) != 19):
            raise AssertionError('independent interpreter produced different complete HIA inputs/results')
        environment.update({'HIA_DELIVERY_SOURCE_ROOT': str(root),
            'HIA_DELIVERY_NATIVE_IMAGE': produced['image_path'],
            'HIA_DELIVERY_NATIVE_SHA256': produced['image_sha256']})
        controls_script = '''import importlib.util,json,sys,unittest
p=sys.argv[1];s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('delivery_controls',p);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m)
suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(m.DeliveryMechanismTests)
assert suite.countTestCases()==18
r=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
value={'tests_run':r.testsRun,'errors':len(r.errors),'failures':len(r.failures),'skipped':len(r.skipped),'expected_failures':len(r.expectedFailures),'unexpected_successes':len(r.unexpectedSuccesses)}
open(sys.argv[2],'w').write(json.dumps(value,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\\n')
assert r.testsRun==18 and r.wasSuccessful() and not(r.skipped or r.expectedFailures or r.unexpectedSuccesses)
'''
        report['mechanism'] = child(out, 'mechanism-controls',
            [sys.executable, '-I', '-S', '-B', '-c', controls_script, str(helpers / 'test_exception_delivery_mechanism.py'),
             str(out / 'mechanism-tests.json')], root, environment, 30)
        after_held = {name: identity(name) for name in held}
        write_json(out / 'held-inputs-after.json', after_held)
        if after_held != held:
            raise AssertionError('held mechanism source, helper or actual compiler changed')
        report['mechanism_counts'] = json_value((out / 'mechanism-tests.json').read_bytes())
        report['complete_vm_native_comparisons'] = len(produced['comparisons'])
        report['source_overlay'] = {path: identity(root / path) for path in SOURCE_FILES}
        report['status'] = 'DEVELOPMENT_PASS'
    except BaseException as error:
        report['status'] = 'FAILED'
        report['error_type'] = type(error).__name__
        (out / 'failure.traceback.txt').write_text(traceback.format_exc())
        raise
    finally:
        if before is not None:
            try:
                after = source_snapshot(root, original_blobs=True)
                write_json(out / 'source-after.json', after)
                report['original_tracked_source_unchanged'] = before == after
                if before != after:
                    report['status'] = 'FAILED_SOURCE_DRIFT'
                report['git_status_after'] = git(root, 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all').decode()
                expected_status = ''.join('?? ' + name + '\n' for name in sorted(SOURCE_FILES))
                if (report['git_status_after'] != expected_status
                        or git(root, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() != BASE_HEAD
                        or git(root, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}').decode().strip() != BASE_TREE):
                    report['status'] = 'FAILED_FINAL_GIT_IDENTITY'
            except BaseException:
                report['status'] = 'FAILED_FINAL_CUSTODY'
                (out / 'final-custody.traceback.txt').write_text(traceback.format_exc())
        write_json(out / 'RESULT.json', report)
    if report['status'] != 'DEVELOPMENT_PASS':
        raise AssertionError('final custody did not attest the completed mechanism run')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Static kit checks only; never launches the workflow or mechanism tests."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ast
from hashlib import sha256
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--packet', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    directory = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    driver_path = directory / 'run_exception_delivery_ci.py'
    workflow_path = directory / 'exception-delivery-development.workflow.template.yml'
    raw = driver_path.read_bytes()
    tree = ast.parse(raw)
    compile(tree, str(driver_path), 'exec')
    for path in (Path(__file__),):
        compile(path.read_bytes(), str(path), 'exec')
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('frozen_development_driver', driver_path)
    driver = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(driver)
    checks = {}

    def check(name, value):
        if not value:
            raise AssertionError(name)
        checks[name] = True

    check('exact_base_head', driver.BASE_HEAD == '7e9c5a796a29746d169f9db97392ec774f627c03')
    check('exact_base_tree', driver.BASE_TREE == '79843bddc6df7306299f0be6475a2fcd187b4d97')
    check('complete_file_count', driver.BASE_FILES == 3084)
    check('original_artifact', driver.ORIGINAL_ARTIFACT_ID == 13910483391 and driver.ORIGINAL_ARTIFACT_BYTES == 68873189
          and driver.ORIGINAL_ARTIFACT_SHA == '082cf9245a6c46959acf75be6c981fa87a6b4f3babaca95232166a9b2fc4e528')
    check('original_compiler', driver.COMPILER_BYTES == 669494 and driver.COMPILER_SHA == '81b6fad94493546b5bf3f858248f25b19aded88bf8f3aaad18140aa317dac109')
    files = driver.packet_files(args.packet)
    check('all_original_packet_members_checked', len(files) == 49)
    check('two_new_product_files_only', set(driver.SOURCE_FILES) == {'hepta/hia_exception_delivery.py', 'tools/hia_exception_delivery.py'})
    for name, digest in driver.SOURCE_FILES.items():
        check('frozen_' + name, sha256(files['source/' + name]).hexdigest() == digest)
    controls = ast.parse(files['recovery-r4/test_exception_delivery_mechanism.py'])
    methods = [node.name for node in controls.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == 'DeliveryMechanismTests'
               for node in node.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name.startswith('test_')]
    check('all_18_controls', len(methods) == 18 and len(set(methods)) == 18)
    check('no_skip_added', not any(isinstance(node, ast.Attribute) and node.attr.startswith('skip') for node in ast.walk(controls)))
    inner = {}
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id in ('script', 'controls_script') for target in node.targets):
            code = ast.literal_eval(node.value)
            compile(code, '<independent child>', 'exec')
            inner[node.targets[0].id] = {'bytes': len(code.encode()), 'sha256': sha256(code.encode()).hexdigest()}
    check('both_child_programs_compile', set(inner) == {'script', 'controls_script'})
    text = raw.decode()
    check('python3144_exact_admission', 'sys.version_info[:3] != (3, 14, 4)' in text)
    check('original_compile_stage_not_replaced', 'compile_stage(' not in text and 'admit_cold_build' not in text)
    check('all_original_source_readback', text.count('source_snapshot(root, original_blobs=True)') == 2)
    check('new_overlay_final_identity', "report['git_status_after'] != expected_status" in text)
    check('source_export_not_forged_git', "['git', '-C', str(root), *args]" in text and 'git init' not in text)
    check('independent_isolated_children', text.count("sys.executable, '-I', '-S', '-B', '-c'") == 2)
    check('native_child_outer_bound', 'root, environment, 60)' in text)
    check('mechanism_outer_bound', 'root, environment, 30)' in text)
    workflow = workflow_path.read_text()
    check('workflow_source_pin', 'ref: ' + driver.BASE_HEAD in workflow)
    check('workflow_python_pin', "python-version: '3.14.4'" in workflow)
    check('workflow_outer240_plus3', 'timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=3s 240s' in workflow)
    check('workflow_upload_even_failure', 'if: always()' in workflow and 'actions/upload-artifact@v4' in workflow)
    check('workflow_no_continue_on_error', 'continue-on-error' not in workflow)
    check('workflow_read_only_permissions', 'contents: read' in workflow and 'actions: read' in workflow and ': write' not in workflow)
    check('only_future_kit_identity_placeholders', set(re.findall(r'__[A-Z0-9_]+__', workflow)) == {'__IMMUTABLE_KIT_BLOB__', '__IMMUTABLE_KIT_SHA256__'})
    check('mechanism_blob_and_sha_fixed', driver.PACKET_BLOB in workflow and driver.PACKET_SHA in workflow)
    lines = workflow.splitlines()
    shell_blocks = []
    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
        if line == '        run: |':
            block = []
            for following in lines[index + 1:]:
                if following and not following.startswith('          '):
                    break
                block.append(following[10:] if following else '')
            shell = '\n'.join(block) + '\n'
            completed = subprocess.run(['bash', '-n'], input=shell.encode(), capture_output=True, timeout=10)
            if completed.returncode:
                raise AssertionError(completed.stderr.decode())
            shell_blocks.append({'bytes': len(shell.encode()), 'sha256': sha256(shell.encode()).hexdigest()})
            for nested in re.findall(r"python - <<'PY'\n(.*?)\nPY\n", shell, re.S):
                compile(nested, '<workflow bootstrap>', 'exec')
    check('all_four_workflow_shell_blocks', len(shell_blocks) == 4)
    print(json.dumps({'schema': 'hia.exception-delivery.ci-kit-static-controls.v1',
        'status': 'STATIC_CONTROLS_PASS_NOT_CI_EXECUTED', 'checks': checks, 'check_count': len(checks),
        'driver': {'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha256(raw).hexdigest()},
        'workflow': {'bytes': len(workflow.encode()), 'sha256': sha256(workflow.encode()).hexdigest()},
        'inner_child_programs': inner, 'shell_blocks': shell_blocks, 'mechanism_methods': methods,
        'python': sys.version, 'actual_python314_mechanism_executed': False}, sort_keys=True, indent=2))
